points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: CMake and README are submitted; raw validator passed in immutable attempt worktree.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: CLI source and documented commands are present.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Source is modularized by mesh, IO, physics and solver.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal wrapper found; trust policy excludes external similarity search.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case-driven CLI supports both supplied meshes.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: MPI artifacts and rank tests exist, but independent parallel rerun was not performed.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Basic checks and error handling are present.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Validator proof and scripts are retained only in immutable attempt evidence.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Readable source; excluded raw data prevents a clean submitted reproduction.

MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source

Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
